provenance.notes: These are ordinary Italian garment, styling and general words that collide with a term in this file or in another language file once the screener folds diacritics or collapses repeated characters. Cocktail, as in abito da cocktail, contains the English entry cock; culotte and culottes contain the Italian entry culo; Figaro, the cropped bolero jacket, contains the Italian entry figa; and puttanesca contains the Italian entry puttana. Allow-list lookup runs on the literal case-folded token, before diacritic and leet folding, so an accented or vulgar spelling is still screened.
